events.notes: Inspection is before closure in the workflow and is required before each draw; the public procedure does not enumerate CS-02 fields or publish per-draw CS-02 records.
The procedure places this confirmation before sales closure, but lists no dedicated register. The final case may differ if the post-close weighing rejects the first case.
SICAL shows status Closed; the summary is printed and signed/rubricated. This is the temporal boundary for same-draw ticket selection.
The activity follows 4.1. The glossary defines the strip as recording the weight of each sphere. The public text does not enumerate its timestamp fields or publish actual strips.
If any weight criterion fails, another case is selected and weighed again. The final selected case is therefore not guaranteed to equal the pre-close planned case.
Progressive loading order is not the same as extraction order. The public procedure does not define a structured per-ball load timestamp.
These signatures protect the closed sales files and are stored with SEGOB/OIC custody. They are generated after close and are not physical-mechanism measurements.

Policy 30 requires recording from sphere weighing through the electronic draw; the edited draw-only copy forms part of the Acta. Cameras record numbers as balls are captured. No public original recording, per-ball timestamps, or RFID telemetry was located.
CS-11 is completed after the draw and attached to the Acta. Its published definition does not include machine asset ID, individual sphere weights, RFID tag IDs, or per-ball extraction timestamps.
Incidents are recorded when an event departs from procedure and affects results; post-draw Acta/CS-09 are retrospective for the same draw.

video_recording_policy.scope: from sphere weighing through the electronic draw
video_recording_policy.purpose: documentary witness for any later clarification

facts: 14 electronic draw machines delivered 2022-03-07: 10 Jupiter, 2 Mercury 5, 2 Mercury 8
10 sphere sets per product are stated, including Chispazo
all machines and spheres are stated to have RFID recognition
public_hardware_evidence.count_inconsistency: The report names seven products and says 10 sets for each (which arithmetically implies 70), but states a total of 60 sets. Do not treat the total set count as verified without clarification.
public_hardware_evidence.limits: This is inventory/capability evidence, not a draw-by-draw machine ID, sphere-set ID, RFID read log, or evidence that an RFID scan was recorded for every draw.

public_data_status.public_rule: The Chispazo regulation identifies the Acta as the official result; website and result mask are informational only.

v265_code_audit.preclose_rule: Every metadata row must be flagged available_before_close and metadata_known_time_local must be strictly earlier than close_time_local.
v265_code_audit.coverage_rule: Metadata CONCURSO coverage must exactly match the history.
v265_code_audit.actionability_risk: The code can set actionable_for_betting=true from positive mean log-lift, Holm p<0.05, complete coverage and the generic preclose timestamp checks, without an anytime e-value gate; this is below the project's stated promotion standard.
v265_code_audit.interpretation: Machine/sphere-set conditional predictive association only; not a physical-bias test.
